args.title: checkout-api failing health checks - rolled back v2.3.1 to v2.3.0

trace.final:
Done. Here's a summary of what happened:

**Problem:** checkout-api v2.3.1 (the latest deploy) was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Rolled back** checkout-api to **v2.3.0** — the most recent production release that was healthy (v2.3.1 was unhealthy; older releases v2.2.9 and v2.3.0 were both healthy, and v2.3.0 was the newer of the two). Rollback completed and verified in all regions. Note: v2.3.1-rc was unhealthy in staging, so it was never a candidate.
2. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** ("checkout-api failing health checks - rolled back v2.3.1 to v2.3.0") describing the failure and the rollback action. The on-call engineer has been paged.

**Recommendation:** Monitor the service to confirm recovery on v2.3.0, and investigate v2.3.1 (including the staging RC that also failed) before attempting a redeploy.
